rows: Mean CFO / net profit 92% over 5 years
1 FLAG / 4 WATCH across 16 accounting tests; LojikX™ Consistency Score 65/100

sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 5.7 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 5.7 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 12.2% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Working Capital Cycle (DSO / DIO): The cash conversion cycle absorbs 404 days of working capital. A long cycle ties up cash and makes growth expensive to fund.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 33 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 1 hard red flags and 4 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 65/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
